{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient entries, keeping the highest sample_seq for each patient
df_clean = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check for negative biomarker values — implausible
print("Negative biomarker values:", (df_clean['biomarker_baseline'] < 0).sum())

# Check the range of biomarker values
print("Biomarker baseline range:", df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].min(), "to", df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].max())"}
